scope: This closes the abstract multiquadratic extension, root selection, sign-character construction, affine Galois action, and transformed-relation premises. It still assumes the specialized radicands are nonzero with pairwise nonsquare products, the lifted points are nonsingular, and the original point relation; it does not prove torsion-to-division-polynomial vanishing, the j=0 CM finite-kernel case, the specialized Semaev polynomial certificate, or the full subexponential ECDLP runtime theorem.
statement: For nonzero radicands with pairwise nonsquare products over an odd-characteristic field, the canonical splitting field of the indexed quadratic factors, its selected roots, its Galois action on short-form affine curve points, and all character-twisted relations are constructed internally; one original zero-sum relation therefore implies that the Galois-group cardinality times the selected integer coefficient annihilates the selected point.
